name: Fade the first break of yesterday high / low
why: Most first breaks of yesterday's high/low (83 %) come back inside within 30 minutes: the break runs the resting stops above/below the level and the initiators unload into them. Pre-registered 2026-10-19 (research/preregistered/2026-10-19_attack_behaviour.md).

scan.when: !rollwin && open < ph && open > pl && ((hi(1,1) > ph && lag(1, hod) <= ph) || (lo(1,1) < pl && lag(1, lod) >= pl))
scan.dir: -((hi(1,1) > ph && lag(1, hod) <= ph) - (lo(1,1) < pl && lag(1, lod) >= pl))
